        <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5268">chos mngon pa kun <choice><reg>las</reg><orig>la</orig></choice> btus pa'i rgyan</rs> ces bya ba × <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4593">mkhan po</rs> dang <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4593">bla ma</rs>'i gsung gi lhag ma dang ¦ x <lb n="208a6"/> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4593">blo gsal 'ga</rs>s bskul pa dang ¦ rang gzhan gyi don du <hi rendition="#Time">shing pho rta'i lo</hi> la ¦ <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5865">btsun <note type="gloss">pa</note> 'khon ston</rs> gyis ¦ <rs type="place" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4352">dpal e'i gtsug lag khang</rs> du sbyar ba rdzogs s+hyo ||       <!--This “Ornament of the Abhidharmasamuccaya” was composed by the Venerable 'Khon ston in the monastery of Shri-E, in 1174/1234/1294/1354/1414/1474/1534, for himself and others, having been asked by some Clear-minded person, ***the rest of the teaching of the instructor and the bla ma.--></seg></TEI>
